name: Question 8
problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 6 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
worked_solution:
The system corresponding to $M$ is

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x-8y+6z=-4 \\ 0x+0y+0z=0 \\ 0x+0y+0z=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Since any numbers $x,y,z$ form a solution of the final two equations $0x+0y+0z=0,$ we can remove these equations from the system. So, our system now consists of just a single equation:

$$
2x-8y+6z=-4
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variable is $x$, and we have two free variables $y$ and $z.$ That means we need to find $x$ in terms of $y,z.$ Doing this, we get

$$
x=4y-3z-2.
$$

Therefore, the general solution is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=4y-3z-2 \\ y=y \\ z=z,\end{aligned}
$$

where $y$, $z$ (free variables) are arbitrary numbers.

In vector form, the solution can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4y-3z-2 \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+y[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+z[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,y,z\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 8
?

Consider the augmented matrix M given by M=[2−86−400000000]. Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

a
[200]+y[−410]+z[301],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
b
[200]+y[410]+z[001],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
c
[−200]+y[010]+z[−301],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
d
No solution
e
[−200]+y[410]+z[−301],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

The system corresponding to M is {2x−8y+6z=−40x+0y+0z=00x+0y+0z=0.

Since any numbers x,y,z form a solution of the final two equations 0x+0y+0z=0, we can remove these equations from the system. So, our system now consists of just a single equation:

2x−8y+6z=−4

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variable is x, and we have two free variables y and z. That means we need to find x in terms of y,z. Doing this, we get

x=4y−3z−2.

Therefore, the general solution is

{x=4y−3z−2y=yz=z,

where y, z (free variables) are arbitrary numbers.

In vector form, the solution can be written as [xyz]=[4y−3z−2yz]=[−200]+y[410]+z[−301],y,z∈(−∞,∞).
